safety_verdicts.content: Patient has no past medical history of anaphylaxis.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated facts do not explicitly state no history of anaphylaxis.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: In a presentation concerning for possible allergic reaction/anaphylaxis, explicitly documenting no prior anaphylaxis helps contextualize risk and guides escalation planning. Omission could contribute to unnecessary heightened concern or, less commonly, underappreciation of baseline risk in future reviews of the note.

safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Whether the patient has previously been prescribed/used an epinephrine auto-injector is clinically relevant to anaphylaxis risk history and preparedness. Omitting this may lead to less informed decision-making or unnecessary repeat counseling/prescribing when the chart is reviewed later.

safety_verdicts.content: Patient has no history of anaphylaxis.
